{
  "verdict": "request",
  "cause": "MAX_TOKENS_TINY",
  "fix": {"action": "raise_max_tokens", "target": "max_new_tokens", "value": "512"},
  "rationale": "The script calls model.generate(**inputs) without max_new_tokens, and generation_config.json sets neither max_new_tokens nor max_length. Transformers therefore uses its default limit of 20 new tokens, and the printed reply is about 20 tokens long and stops mid-word at 'The'. The end-of-sequence setting is correct: eos_token_id includes 151645 (<|im_end|>), which is the token the Qwen2.5 chat template ends a turn with. The wording changes between runs because generation_config.json sets do_sample=true with temperature 0.7, which is normal behaviour, and model size has nothing to do with the cut-off."
}

json
{
  "verdict": "request",
  "cause": "MAX_TOKENS_TINY",
  "fix": {"action": "raise_max_tokens", "target": "max_new_tokens", "value": "512"},
  "rationale": "The script calls model.generate(**inputs) without max_new_tokens, and generation_config.json sets neither max_new_tokens nor max_length. Transformers therefore uses its default limit of 20 new tokens, and the printed reply is about 20 tokens long and stops mid-word at 'The'. The end-of-sequence setting is correct: eos_token_id includes 151645 (<|im_end|>), which is the token the Qwen2.5 chat template ends a turn with. The wording changes between runs because generation_config.json sets do_sample=true with temperature 0.7, which is normal behaviour, and model size has nothing to do with the cut-off."
}
